summary: @ornikar/lerna-config preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: On `npm install`, the package's `preinstall` hook runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime (v1.3.13) from GitHub releases into a temp directory, chmods it 0755, and invokes it against a package-local `math_init.js` blob (~727 KB) via `execFileSync`. `math_init.js` is heavily obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style hex-mangled identifiers, shuffled numeric string-array with a rotation function, `@bun @bun-cjs` banner) and is not referenced from the library's `main` entry (`index.js`), so its behavior is hidden from anyone reading the readable JS. `setup.mjs` itself uses hex-mangled variable names. The alternate runtime is used specifically to execute the shipped obfuscated payload — a Node-scoped scanner would not run this code path. The legitimate `@ornikar/lerna-config` release history has no `preinstall` script and does not ship `math_init.js`, consistent with a hijacked or impersonation publish.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
